system.description:
Trained under Arikh Evergreen, Elder of the Nalwood Forest and Hierophant of the Cabal. The Nalwood circle is one of the Cabal's oldest seats, deep in old-growth woodland.

  • Forest Vigour: Healing you cast restores +1 HP per die.
  • Ancient Lore: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in old-growth forest environments without designating them as a trained region.
